description: This file defines an Android activity 'FragmentArguments' that demonstrates the use of fragments with configurable arguments via Bundle and layout attributes. It includes an inner class 'MyFragment' that manages arguments, inflates views, and interacts with activity resources.

classes.name: FragmentArguments
classes.description: An activity demonstrating fragment creation and management, initializing a fragment with arguments.

classes.name: MyFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that supports initialization with arguments, inflates a view, and sets its label dynamically based on attributes or arguments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds a fragment instance if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MyFragment with a specified label argument.

methods.name: onInflate
methods.description: Inflates the fragment during layout inflation, extracting styled attributes for configuration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles fragment creation, restoring label from arguments if available.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view hierarchy for the fragment, setting the label text and background.
